answer: On a shared meadow each agent tends a plot of ten square meters for a full season, cutting grass at harvest and burning it in a clay kiln until a single ember fires one clay token stamped with the plot number. The token goes into a locked vault beside the meadow, and once a year the keeper opens the vault and counts tokens against the plot register, so a second token from the same plot voids both and the plot loses its harvest for a season. A thousand fake names need a thousand tended plots, a thousand kiln firings, and a thousand tokens in the vault.
